Adult giraffes typically stand **14 to 18 feet (4.3 to 5.5 meters)** tall.

Males are generally taller than females, with males reaching the upper end of that range and females averaging closer to **14 feet (4.3 meters)**.

Their height is mostly due to their extremely long necks (about 6 feet / 1.8 meters) and legs. Even newborn giraffes are impressive—standing about **6 feet (1.8 meters)** tall at birth.
